watch_outs: Contractor Registration Required: Washington requires all contractors to register with L&I Washington contractors must be registered with Labor & Industries—verify at lni.wa.gov. Registration includes a surety bond. Reddit users appreciate that you can check complaint history online.

Moisture & Mold Prevention: Western Washington Seattle area gets 150+ days of rain. Reddit strongly emphasizes proper flashing, ventilation, and vapor barriers. Mold remediation is expensive—prevention is essential.

Seismic Considerations: Washington faces significant earthquake risk, especially near Puget Sound The Cascadia Subduction Zone poses major risk. Reddit recommends seismic retrofitting for older homes, especially those with cripple walls or unreinforced masonry.

Energy Code Requirements: Washington has strict energy codes that exceed national standards Washington energy code requires high insulation values and air sealing. Reddit users note that meeting code adds cost but significantly reduces heating bills.
Roof & Moss Prevention: Western Washington Moss damages roofing materials over time. Reddit recommends zinc or copper strips at the ridge, regular cleaning, and algae-resistant shingles.
